messages.Обнаружен установленный сервер. Повторна: An existing server was detected. Reinstallation and reconfiguration are disabled.
messages.Укажите параметры существующего подключе: Enter the existing connection settings and its client configuration. Saving only adds a local profile: server settings and authorized clients will not change.
messages.Соединение работает. Для части потоков т: The connection is active. Some streams require VK verification.
messages.Для подключения требуется проверка VK в: VK verification in the browser is required to connect.
messages.ICMP до адреса сервера, примерно раз в 5: ICMP to the server address, approximately every 5 seconds. This is not the latency of the entire VPN tunnel. Uses the current system routes. If ICMP is blocked or ping is unavailable, ‘—’ is shown.
Unsaved changes will be lost. Continue?
messages.Выберите сервер слева или добавьте новый: Select a server on the left or add a new one to connect via free-turn-proxy.
messages.freeturn:// ссылка от владельца сервера: freeturn:// link from the server owner
messages.В ссылке есть WireGuard-конфиг — после и: The link includes a WireGuard configuration — connect with one click after import (built-in VPN).
messages.WireGuard-конфига в ссылке нет — будет р: No WireGuard configuration in the link — relay mode requires a separate WireGuard/AmneziaWG client.
messages.Нажмите, чтобы подключиться к выбранному: Click to connect to the selected server
messages.Добавьте первый сервер, чтобы начать: Add your first server to get started
messages.Пароль sudo (если отличается от пароля в: Sudo password (if different from login password)
messages.Ваша ссылка на звонок VK Calls (можно до: Your VK Calls link (can be added later)
messages.Развернём free-turn-proxy и интерфейс Wi: We will deploy free-turn-proxy and the WireGuard interface (ft-wg0), start them with obfuscation and add you as the first authorized client.
messages.Конфиг WireGuard/AmneziaWG для отдельног: WireGuard/AmneziaWG configuration for an external client (Endpoint already points to the local relay)
messages.При входе в сеанс Linux. Автоподключение: When signing in to Linux. Automatic connection is configured separately below.
messages.Одна попытка при каждом запуске приложен: One attempt on each application launch, including at login.
messages.Капча может потребовать ручного ввода. П: Captcha may require manual input. If the connection fails, try again manually.
messages.Закрытие окна не прерывает соединение. В: Closing the window keeps the connection active. Quit using the tray menu.
messages.Системный трей недоступен. В GNOME нужно: System tray unavailable. GNOME requires an AppIndicator / KStatusNotifierItem extension. Without a tray, closing the window exits the app and disconnects the VPN.
messages.Скачано / отдано пользователем с момента: User download / upload since WireGuard started on the server
messages.Ссылка слишком длинная для QR-кода — отп: The link is too long for a QR code — send it as text.
messages.Отправьте ссылку или покажите QR: пользо: Send the link or show the QR code: importing it into the app adds the server with a working WireGuard configuration.
The user will enter their own VK call link.
messages.VPN-режим в одну кнопку доступен только: One-click VPN is available for servers deployed with “New VPS”, which generates a WireGuard configuration. Only relay mode is available for this server.
messages.Сейчас подключён другой сервер — переклю: Another server is connected — switching will disconnect it first.
messages.Направьте на этот адрес Endpoint в вашем: Set this as the Endpoint in your WireGuard/AmneziaWG client (relay configuration, MTU 1280), then enable VPN.
messages.Автоматические маршруты к TURN-серверам: Automatic TURN server routes (administrator authorization required)
messages.Удалить free-turn-proxy и управляемый Wi: Remove free-turn-proxy and the managed WireGuard interface from this VPS? The profile in the app will be kept.
messages.Конфиг WireGuard/AmneziaWG для отдельног: WireGuard/AmneziaWG configuration for an external client
messages.Репозиторий обновлений не задан при сбор: No update repository configured in this build. Set UPDATE_REPOSITORY for local builds.
messages.Через 10 секунд после запуска, затем каж: 10 seconds after launch, then every 6 hours using the public GitHub API.
messages.Архив проверен по SHA-256 и сохранён:: Archive verified with SHA-256 and saved:
messages.Белый список: только указанные адреса че: Whitelist: only listed addresses use VPN. Blacklist: listed addresses bypass VPN. Whitelists are combined; blacklist exclusions take priority. With no enabled whitelist, the full profile AllowedIPs range is used. Rules apply only to the built-in VPN, not relay mode or the separate CLI client.
messages.Домены, IP и подсети — по одной записи в: Domains, IPs and subnets — one entry per line
messages.Домены разрешаются через системный DNS п: Domains are resolved using system DNS at connection time; reconnect if their IPs change. Use exact names without https://, paths or *. Add subdomains separately. Sites sharing an IP may match the same rule; browser DNS/DoH may resolve different IPs. Rules only cover WireGuard AllowedIPs ranges: an IPv4-only configuration does not cover IPv6. Profile DNS servers keep their service VPN routes even when blacklisted. On Linux, SSH follows profile routes: include the VPS address in VPN routes to reach it through the VPN. The relay's own connections use the physical interface. This is routing, not blocking or leak protection.
Up to 16 lists and 256 entries per profile. Save and reconnect to apply.
messages.Изменение списков недоступно, пока этот: Lists cannot be edited while this profile is connected.
messages.Получаем информацию о последнем стабильн: Fetching the latest stable release information.
messages.Подтвердите установку или выберите место: Confirm installation or select a destination in the open dialog.
Waiting for the GitHub download server.
messages.VPN продолжает работать до завершения по: VPN stays connected until preparation is complete.
messages.Архив скачан. Проверяем целостность и со: Archive downloaded. Verifying integrity and saving the file.
messages.Проверяем состав архива и архитектуру. У: Checking archive contents and architecture. Installed files are not changed yet.
VPN will disconnect and the window will close. Installation continues separately; wait for the new version to launch.
messages.Удалить пользователя «{name}»? Его подкл: Delete user “{name}”? Their connection will stop working immediately.
messages.Источник: github.com/{repository}. Тольк: Source: github.com/{repository}. Stable releases only; keys and profiles are never sent.
messages.Нажмите уведомление или «Открыть в брауз: Click this notification or ‘Open in browser’ to complete verification.
messages.Откройте FreeTurn и нажмите «Открыть про: Open FreeTurn and click ‘Open verification in browser’.
